webster.text: Literally, a flowing to, or concourse.

more.text: Figuratively, abundance of riches; great plenty of worldly goods; wealth.

example.quote: Does not Virginia surpass every state in the Union, in number of inhabitants, extent of territory, felicity of position, and affluence and wealth ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
